K=1 negative-control false-positive rates. The k1-stage0-acceptance-v2 experiment. (A) False
double-well topology in pure noise. (B) False target selection in pure noise. (C) False
double-well topology in single-well data. (D) False target selection in single-well data. Black
points show per-cell false-positive rates by feature count; Open points identify incomplete
frozen cells; the red horizontal line marks the frozen 5% maximum. The estimand is Each rate
uses all requested replicates in its control and grid cell, including failed executions in the
denominator.. Rates remain descriptive until every frozen replicate is present and the
complete-cell acceptance rules are applied. The displayed execution is incomplete and cannot
establish acceptance. Both negative-control false-positive rates must not exceed 5%. Negative
controls measure false topology and false target selection; pure noise has no planted subspace
recovery target.
